==Description==
The '''Roblox Core Pack - Accelerator''' is an official Roblox toy that was released in January of 2022. The toy offers the default Level 5 [[Accelerator]]. When you buy the toy, one redeemable code is given, which allows you to get the {{RLinkC|7243893547|Dual Canister Backpack}} accessory on Roblox. The toy is recommended for ages 6+ and is not suitable for children under 3 years old.

==Official Description==
*'''Online'''
*:Rev up your defenses with the Accelerator from Paradoxum Games' Tower Defense Simulator. Once this defender gets warmed up, there's no stopping the incredible destructive power they can put out. Just set them up and watch the forces of evil melt under the blistering assault.
*'''On Pack'''
*:Once the Accelerator from Paradoxum Games' Tower Defense Simulator gets warmed up, there's no stopping the destruction they can put.

==Prices & Stores==
Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency.

The stores in which you can buy the '''Roblox Core Pack - Accelerator''' depends on country. The toy is subject to availability.

==Trivia==
*Despite being based on the default Level 5 [[Accelerator]], multiple parts of the toy are blue instead of purple, bearing more similarities to the default Level 4 [[Accelerator]].
